svg.title: Heart rate on a hill: fakemy.run vs Runsketch
svg.desc: Line chart of a 28-minute, 5 km run with one hill. fakemy.run's heart rate is a noisy hump that peaks at half-time on flat ground and falls during the climb. Runsketch's heart-rate demand rises on the climb and drops at the crest, and its recorded heart rate lags behind: it runs about 6 bpm under demand partway up the climb, crosses over and sits 6 to 7 bpm above it by the top, and past the crest holds 13 to 15 bpm above demand for half a minute before closing to within 2 bpm about two minutes later.
